change: One scroll bar: the window frame no longer scrolls, and the pane below the title bar owns the only scroll bar.
cause: .visually-hidden was absolutely positioned without a positioned ancestor, so the hidden report file input sat below the content and stretched the document to 1016 pt in a 855 pt window, adding a second window-level scroll bar.

newTests: the page scroll bar belongs to the pane below the title bar
a loaded report keeps the document inside the window
every page scrolls in the pane without a second window scroll bar

native.note: The capture is scrolled to the bottom of the report; the only bar runs from under the title bar to the window bottom edge.

limits: The packaged .app lives on the exFAT external disk where codesign cannot write, so the build was verified from a locally signed copy. Narrow windows (<= 700 pt) stack the sidebar and scroll the document by design.
